pre_registered.reproduction: exact S00 selected B-stave pulse count from raw h101/HRDv ROOT
pre_registered.split: leave one Sample-II analysis run out; train correction models on all other Sample-II analysis runs
pre_registered.traditional_method: generalized least-squares matched-template/CFD correction using run-excluded pedestal, phase, and pile-up bins
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest held-out paired-bootstrap sigma68_ns among correction methods; ties break by lower |residual|>0.5 ns tail and then lower absolute bias

next_tickets.title: S58c: external trigger validation of causal pedestal-phase timing corrections
next_tickets.body: Repeat the S58a pedestal-phase timing panel against an external clock/trigger reference rather than same-event downstream-pair residuals, preserving the same run-held-out split and pedestal/pile-up strata. Expected information gain: separates absolute timing improvement from pair-symmetry corrections that may cancel common-mode errors.
